reason: The plugin is primarily a user-interface customization tool: it adds a Dream Skin panel inside DeepSeek Harness Web settings for theme management. Evidence from the package manifest and README shows its main behavior is selecting, creating, importing/exporting, and persisting visual themes with optional background image configuration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的主题管理插件，在设置中提供 Dream Skin 换肤入口，用于切换、创建、导入/导出主题并配置背景图。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness Web theme manager that adds a Dream Skin panel in settings for switching, creating, importing, and exporting themes with optional background image setup.

capabilities: Registers a custom DSH web client UI settings page for theme switching
Injects browser-side CSS theme overrides into the web interface
Supports creating, importing (zip/theme.json), and exporting theme definitions
Manages optional background image settings for themes
Stores theme state and preferences in browser localStorage
Includes installation logic that patches local DSH profile/entry files

reasons.code: Repository README describes a Dream Skin visual theme picker with create/import/export and background image features in DeepSeek Harness Web settings.
